run_pipeline_for_tokens: run the inference pipeline to label PDF document chunks with educational scores using a teacher model
create_rollout_teacher: create an async rollout function that scores PDF text chunks on educational value using a vLLM teacher model
build_inference_config: build an InferenceConfig for vLLM with fp8 quantization, 16384 context window, and 400 concurrent generations

run_local_executor: run a LocalPipelineExecutor to execute the inference pipeline across GPU nodes
